english.title: Failing to provide prescribed information after fine / compensation / unlawful profit / slavery and trafficking order
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having had a fine, compensation order, unlawful profit order or slavery and trafficking reparation order imposed upon you by **(.. SPECIFY NAME OF MAGISTRATES' COURT..), failed to provide prescribed information in connection with an application by the court to the Secretary of State, asking him to deduct sums from any amounts payable to you by way of income support, job seeker's allowance or state pension credit, in order to secure payment of any sum which is or forms part of the fine or order
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 24(2)(aa), 24(2A) and 24(2C) of the Criminal Justice Act 1991.
